description: unknowns — reminder to record plan deviations during implementation (IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md), plus a read-only guard for the plugin's sub-agents. The reminder fires in projects that already use the methodology (an IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md or a .unknowns/ directory; UNKNOWNS_NOTES_ALWAYS=1 for every project) when file edits reach N (default 10), once per session by default; it is restated after compaction and once at Stop if notes were never written. UNKNOWNS_NOTES_THRESHOLD adjusts the threshold (0=off); UNKNOWNS_NOTES_REPEAT=1 repeats at every threshold multiple; legacy FIELD_GUIDE_NOTES_THRESHOLD is still recognized. UNKNOWNS_AGENT_GUARD=0 disables the sub-agent Bash guard.
